narrative.overview: The live surface reads like a directory listing rendered in a shell: monospace type throughout, hard-edged bordered rows standing in for cards, lowercase bracket tags ([topic]) standing in for pills, and an underline standing in for an active/selected state. There is exactly one ink color and one paper color, swapped wholesale between light and dark — no accent hue, no gradient, no photography, no illustration. Depth is expressed only through the border and through inverting ink/paper on hover, never through shadow or blur. This restraint is deliberate and load-bearing: the site indexes a researcher's publications, talks, and open-source tools, and its job is to get a visitor from the list to the actual paper/repo/slide in one click.
keyCharacteristics: Pure two-tone ink/paper palette, no accent color
Monospace type at a single size (text-sm) carrying every role
Square corners everywhere; zero border-radius on the live surface
Zero shadows; depth = 1px border + full ink/paper inversion on hover
Bracket notation ([label]) as the recurring tag/filter affordance
Underline-with-offset as the only selected/active signal

rules.name: The Two-Tone Rule
rules.body: The system never introduces a third color. No accent, no semantic red/green, no brand hue.

rules.name: The One Size Rule
rules.body: There is no larger/smaller type step anywhere on the live pages. Weight and structure carry hierarchy, not scale.

rules.name: The Invert-Not-Lift Rule
rules.body: Interactive rows respond to hover/focus by inverting ink and paper, never by adding shadow, scale, or blur.

rules.name: The Square Rule
rules.body: Radius is 0 everywhere on the live surface. Do not introduce rounded corners into the shipped system.

dos: Do keep every interactive surface a 1px square-cornered border with full ink/paper inversion on hover.
Do use lowercase bracket notation ([topic]) for tags/filters instead of colored pills.
Do keep type to the single monospace stack at text-sm; use weight and letter-spacing, not size, to differentiate roles.
Do keep layout single-column and capped at max-w-3xl on every page.
donts: Don't introduce border-radius, box-shadow, or an accent color into any live page — that is the orphaned card/hero language and is explicitly rejected.
Don't add a display/headline type size. The flat one-size hierarchy is intentional.
Don't add photography, illustration, or gradient backgrounds to the overview or detail pages.
Don't extend or wire up theme-provider.tsx's context without reconciling it with the theme-toggle.tsx implementation that actually ships.
